scope: The timber twin-porch and central-gable Cloncurry Post Office around 1910, after its 1906 construction. Includes the raised original office, verandahs, steps and corrugated hip roof. The separate postmaster’s residence and later exchange additions are outside this historical exterior.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The official register dates the standard T17 twin-porch timber post office to 1906 and describes low stumps, central projecting gable, hipped corrugated roof and timber porch steps.
The State Library identifies its ca.1910 stagecoach and post office photo as accession 83-2-6, negative 39810.
